allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: KPI Green Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 1,01,00,000 fully convertible equity warrants to Quyosh Energia Private Limited, an entity belonging to the Promoter Group category on preferential basis. Detailed disclosure is enclosed herewith.

allot.subject: Preferential issue
allot.text: KPI Green Energy Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors of the Company at its meeting held today, considered and approved raising of funds through issuance of warrants to an entity belonging to the promoter group category, by way of preferential issue on private placement basis, subject to approval of the members of the Company. Disclosure is attached herewith.

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: KPI Green Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about Allotment of secured, listed, rated, senior, redeemable, transferable, non-convertible certified green bonds aggregating INR 670,00,00,000 (Indian Rupees Six Hundred and Seventy Crores only) ( Debentures ), in dematerialised form, on a private placement basis to identified investors. Disclosure is attached herewith.

allot.subject: Issue of Securities
allot.text: KPI Green Energy Limited has informed the Exchange about issuance of secured, listed, rated, listed, senior, secured, redeemable, transferable, non-convertible certified  green  bonds aggregating INR 670,00,00,000 (Indian Rupees Six Hundred and Seventy Crore only) in one or more tranches or series ( Debentures ), in dematerialised form, on a private placement basis ( Issue ), to eligible investors

allot.text: KPI Green Energy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Allotment of bonus shares at the ratio of 1 : 2, i.e 1 Equity Shares for every 2 Equity Shares held.'.

allot.subject: Bonus
allot.text: KPI Green Energy Limited has informed the Exchange that the Board of Directors at its meeting held on January 06, 2025, have approved allotment of bonus shares at the ratio of 1 : 2, i.e 1 Equity Shares for every 2 Equity Shares held.
